feat(machines): a plasma machine kind and the Tormach 1300PL

A `.mch` may declare `"kind": "plasma"`: X/Y cut, Z is the torch lifter,
no spindle. The plasma rules (no spindle keys, live tool, coolant or
rotary) refuse by name at the reader and the Machines pane's validator
from one list (post::machine::plasma_refusals), and Machine::is_sane
holds them for project files. The machine check on a plasma table judges
X/Y travel and feed and the changer count, refuses non-plasma ops and
spindle rpm by name, and skips Z depth/travel and rpm with named
MachineCheck notes (shown on the status line's machine vote). The
command door refuses milling/turning ops on a plasma setup; no post
serves a plasma table until the plasma post ships (PLASMA_POSTS).

The Tormach 1300PL ships (UM10720 v1223A §2.2.1, p.16; spec sheet
03/24): X 48.5 / Y 50 / Z 3.9 in (the smaller of manual and sheet),
1000 IPM X/Y, 120 IPM Z, rapid unstated, inch, one torch (Tool 1).
Kerf is the torch tool's diameter (docs/decisions/669-plasma-kind.md).

Kind moves to post/src/machine/kind.rs and the check's per-move helpers
to app/src/machine/judge.rs (400-line law).

Fixes #669

feat(plasma): a plasma profile operation - kerf, leads, cut direction, small holes, inner first

A torch tool kind (ToolKind::Torch): its diameter is the kerf width (the
editor labels it "Kerf width"), no corner, rpm 0 by law - a torch stating
an rpm is refused by name at AddTool / ChangeTool / the library reader;
PT-KERF-150 (1.5 mm) ships in the catalog; the kind round-trips the
project file.

The Plasma Profile (OpType 39, appended; Family::Plasma, Section::Plasma)
cuts picked closed contours and open runs - or the model's through-
silhouette - through the plate in one pass at the plate top (+ the cut
height when stated). Kerf offset by kerf/2 to the waste side in the
computer by default; G41/G42 as the option (CompSpans carry the part
contour with straight engage / cancel leads at least the kerf radius
long). Outer contours CW, holes CCW (Hypertherm); `reversed` flips both
and says so. Arc lead-in / lead-out on the waste side (halved when they
find no room, noted; refused past that). Small holes (Ø < 32 mm or
< 1.5x thickness, LinuxCNC Plasma Primer §13): pierce at the centre,
perpendicular lead-in, no lead-out, optional overburn, 65 % feed.
Cut order is the nesting tree's post-order - an island before its hole,
every hole before its part's outline. Feed, pierce height, cut height and
pierce delay are optional (blank = the controller's AutoFS). The
generator certifies a kerf law: no lit move's kerf reaches the part.
Degenerate input - zero-length or collinear contours, self-crossing
contours or runs, kerf <= 0, a hole the kerf cannot enter (named by
contour id), a pinched gap - is refused by name.

The CL carries the plasma record for #671 / #672 (Toolpath::plasma,
cl::PlasmaCut / TorchSpan): `; PLASMA KERF<um> [CONTROL] [PIERCE<um>]
[CUTH<um>] [DELAY<ms>] [AUTOFEED] [REVERSED]`, `; TORCH ON C<id>
OUTER|INNER|OPEN [PARENT<id>] [SMALL<f x1000>]` before the first lit
move, `; TORCH OFF C<id>` after the last (.cl v5; text dump and project
path cache round-trip; docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md). Golden:
tests/golden/plasma_plate_with_holes.cl.

Wired through #669's seams: cuts_plasma answers the family, the family
door names both directions (a mill-turn no longer admits every family),
the ribbon shows the Plasma section on a plasma table only, the op page
(plasma_page.rs), the machine check judges the op's XY travel and feed.
Decisions: docs/decisions/670-plasma-profile.md.

Fixes #670

feat(post): a PathPilot plasma post for the Tormach 1300PL

tormach-plasma.cps ("Tormach PathPilot Plasma", the first PLASMA_POSTS
entry) voices a plasma profile in PathPilot's plasma words, from
UM10720 §6.2-6.3 and §7.1-7.2 and the PathPilot Post Processor
Guidelines: G20/G21 per the machine, G64 P0.005 Q0.005 (inches), the
work offset, G43 H1, G30; per contour G0 X Y to the pierce point, M200
(AutoFS), M207/M208/M209 when the op states them, G15, G16, the XY cut
(G41.1/G42.1 D<kerf> and G40 under control compensation; no F under
AutoFS), M205, G30; then M30. No Z, S, M3-M9, M6 or % is written.
Refused by name: a non-plasma op, a Plasma Profile path with no plasma
record, an rpm, coolant, a rotary or tilt, a Z cutting move, a cycle,
a machine not declared plasma.

The stream carries the torch: PLASMA / TORCH ON / TORCH OFF records
(the .cl v5 records without their "; ", one reader for both), dumped
around each span, with the hooks onPlasma / onTorchOn / onTorchOff and
an engine torch law (no torch without a header, no ON while lit, no
rapid while lit, nothing left lit; a script without the torch hooks -
every milling post - is refused). machine.kind reaches the script.

Goldens: nc/tormach-plasma/plasma_plate_with_holes{,_mm,_control}.nc.
Decisions: docs/decisions/671-plasma-post.md.

Fixes #671
